SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. Y.
Date ____ 1 . 2 . 29

February 1st,    9

My dear Shelley,

With reference to your
I.S.I. B/214 of January 29, inquiries show
that Mr. George B. Cressey, American citizen,
joined the staff of the Shanghai College and
Middle School some five years ago as Professor
of Geology. He is only a part time teacher and,
when not engaged in College, travels extensively
in North China collecting data regarding the
flora and fauna of that part of the country.
There is nothing in the Police records regarding
him, but as far as can be ascertained he is a
very respectable person who is undoubtedly sincere
in his request.

The Shanghai College was established
about 20 years ago by the American Baptist Mission.
It is still controlled by this body, although the
principalship has been given to a Chinese in
consequence of the new Education Law of the
Nationalist Government.

Yours sincerely,

Capt. J.P. Shelley,
North China Command.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记科
编号 I. O. D. Y.
日期 ____ 1 . 2 . 29

1929年2月1日，

亲爱的谢利：

关于你方1月29日发出的I.S.I. B/214号函件，经查询显示，美国公民乔治·B·克雷西先生约于五年前加入沪江大学及附中教职员队伍，担任地质学教授。他仅为兼职教师，在不从事学院教学工作期间，广泛游历华北地区，收集该地区动植物方面的资料。警方档案中并无关于他的记录，但据查，他是一位非常体面的人士，其请求无疑出于诚意。

沪江大学约于二十年前由美国浸信会传教团创办。尽管根据国民政府的新教育法，校长一职已由中国人担任，但该机构仍受美国浸信会传教团控制。

此致

敬礼

J.P. 谢利上尉，
华北指挥部。
